headword: {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}

definitions.gloss: kitchen work; cooking and kitchen chores
definitions.explanation: Work done in the kitchen, including cooking, washing dishes, cleaning, and food preparation. Refers to the everyday domestic labor of meal-related tasks.

examples.japanese: {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}は{毎日|まいにち}{大変|たいへん}だ。
examples.english: Kitchen work is tough every day.

examples.japanese: {母|はは}は{朝|あさ}から{台所仕事|だいどころしごと}に{追|お}われている。
examples.english: My mother has been busy with kitchen work since morning.

examples.japanese: {共働|ともばたら}きの{家庭|かてい}では、{台所仕事|だいどころしごと}を{夫婦|ふうふ}で{分担|ぶんたん}するのが{当|あ}たり{前|まえ}になってきた。
examples.english: In dual-income households, it has become normal for couples to share kitchen duties.

notes:
Composed of {台所|だいどころ} (kitchen) and {仕事|しごと} (work, task). A compound noun referring to the full range of kitchen-related domestic labor. Has a slightly traditional or homey feel compared to more modern terms like {家事|かじ}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}をする: to do kitchen work
- {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}に{追|お}われる: to be chased by kitchen duties
- {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}を{手伝|てつだ}う: to help with kitchen work
- {台所仕事|だいどころしごと}を{分担|ぶんたん}する: to share kitchen duties

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {家事|かじ}: housework — broader term covering all domestic chores, not just kitchen-related ones
- {炊事|すいじ}: cooking — focuses specifically on the act of cooking meals, not cleaning or preparation
- {料理|りょうり}: cooking, cuisine — the act of preparing food, more focused on the creative/skill aspect
- {水仕事|みずしごと}: water work — kitchen and laundry tasks involving water; often used when discussing chapped hands in winter
